sn35.139:1.1: yaṃ bhikkhave na tumhākaṃ taṃ pajahatha
sn35.139:1.2: taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
sn35.139:1.5: te pajahatha te vo pahīnā hitāya sukhāya bhavissanti.
sn35.139:1.11: te vo pahīnā hitāya sukhāya bhavissanti.
sn35.139:1.12: seyyathāpi bhikkhave yaṃ imasmiṃ jetavane tiṇakaṭṭhasākhāpalāsaṃ …pe…
sn35.139:1.13: evameva kho bhikkhave rūpā na tumhākaṃ te pajahatha te vo pahīnā hitāya sukhāya bhavissanti. saddā gandhā rasā phoṭṭhabbā dhammā na tumhākaṃ te pajahatha
sn35.139:1.14: te vo pahīnā hitāya sukhāya bhavissantīti.
